principle: Every external feature must be dated, source-linked and available at the forecast origin. Revisions and publication lags are retained so future information cannot leak into historical tests.

drivers.variable: Planning stage, stage age and milestone history
drivers.reason: The strongest project-specific evidence and observable for every historical forecast origin.

drivers.variable: Capacity revisions, data completeness and observation count
drivers.source: Derived from dated DESNZ REPD snapshots
drivers.reason: Captures project churn and how much public evidence is available without using future records.

drivers.variable: Prior portfolio size and delivery track record
drivers.source: Derived from dated DESNZ REPD snapshots
drivers.reason: Uses only projects and operational outcomes observed before each forecast date.

drivers.variable: Wholesale electricity price level and volatility
drivers.treatment: Manual stress input until dated history is archived
drivers.reason: Project economics depend on expected captured revenue, but a single spot price is too noisy to use directly.

drivers.variable: Bank Rate, gilt yields and credit conditions
drivers.status: Bank Rate live; yield curve next
drivers.treatment: Live context and manual stress input
drivers.reason: Financing conditions matter most for large, early-stage and capital-intensive projects.

drivers.source: Office for National Statistics Construction Output Price Indices
drivers.reason: A broad UK infrastructure-cost measure that can be archived with its publication vintage.

drivers.variable: Copper, aluminium, iron ore and energy prices
drivers.source: World Bank Commodity Markets Pink Sheet
drivers.reason: Material exposure differs between solar, wind, storage and grid-connected infrastructure.

drivers.variable: Connection agreement, queue position and target connection date
drivers.source: National Energy System Operator connections registers
drivers.reason: Connection readiness is likely to add more project-level signal than broad market sentiment.

drivers.variable: CfD award, strike price, delivery year and allocation round
drivers.source: DESNZ allocation results and Low Carbon Contracts Company register
drivers.status: Award flag live; contract detail next
drivers.reason: A project-specific support contract is more informative than generic political sentiment.

drivers.variable: Dated policy events, planning reform and technology-specific support
drivers.source: GOV.UK Content API and UK Parliament APIs
drivers.treatment: Source-linked event features; no free-form LLM probability adjustment
drivers.reason: Events need effective dates, topic labels and publication-time controls before they can enter a backtest.

drivers.variable: Accounts recency, insolvency flags and filing status
drivers.reason: Broader coverage than stock prices, but operator-to-company matching and filing lags require QA.

drivers.variable: Developer share return, volatility and drawdown
drivers.treatment: Publicly listed developers only; never imputed to private firms
drivers.reason: Stock prices can reflect financing stress but cover only a biased subset of developers and are not project economics.

drivers.variable: Curtailment, negative-price hours and regional constraint exposure
drivers.reason: More decision-relevant than headline power prices for technologies exposed to capture-price erosion.
